entities.name: King Amjad
entities.description: Cruel tyrant who ruled the land of Amjad and brought servants to the Heart of Shanodin to learn their true nature.

entities.name: Heart of Shanodin
entities.description: Place where Amjad brought servants to reveal their nature.

events.summary: Amjad brings his servants into the Heart of Shanodin to know the real nature of those he keeps at his side.
events.quote: in order to know the real nature of those whom he chooses to keep at his side.
